title: EPA ECHO original measurements, calculated monitoring-period loads and annual context

dmr_measurements_2023.csv.basis: One complete original DischargeMonitoringReports object per row, with its original facility, permitted feature and parameter parents.
dmr_measurements_2023.csv.missing_original_units: Keep DMRUnitDesc null. StdUnitDesc applies specifically to DMRValueStdUnits; it does not rewrite the original DMRUnitDesc.
dmr_measurements_2023.csv.quantity_note: Quantity values may be rates such as kg/d; no mass is obtained by summing arbitrary raw measured values.

dmr_loads_monitoring_period_2023.csv.basis: EPA-selected DMR measurements and calculated load for each original monitoring-period row.

dmr_annual_history_2007_2026.csv.annualization: Treat values as EPA published annual outputs. A p_est=N request is not sufficient evidence that the returned load is an unscaled sum; the 2023 period comparison demonstrates otherwise for upper/middle TN.
dmr_annual_history_2007_2026.csv.current_year: 2026 is incomplete at capture. The original period source includes seven December 31 placeholders with nonnumeric load and NmbrOfReport=0; all are retained and marked as future periods.

dmr_annual_estimation_2023.csv.factor_basis: EPA defines factor as 12 divided by months with DMR data plus months with no discharge. Published factors are retained as displayed and never applied a second time.

dmr_2023_mass_context.csv.period_sum: Sum numeric original PollutantLoad0 values for the exact permit/feature/location/parameter; leave nonnumeric periods missing and count them. No annual extrapolation or raw EFF aggregation.
dmr_2023_mass_context.csv.comparison: Published annual values and both query estimation selectors remain separate from the period sum. Both annual captures return the same displayed pollutant loads; factors differ.
dmr_2023_mass_context.csv.source_rounding: Annual and period values are API display strings. Sums use the retained displayed period values; rounding differences are expected.

dmr_facility_coordinates.csv.scope: Each method applies only to that CWA facility coordinate pair.

dmr_permit_feature_coordinates.csv.source_methods: The loading response provides no coordinate determination method or datum field. Preserve original null method and exact source record; do not borrow the facility method.
dmr_permit_feature_coordinates.csv.historical_scope: All unique permit-feature coordinate pairs from the annual history are retained. Milliken feature 001 appears in historical load records; its 2023 EFF records are toxicity parameters.

dmr_loads_monitoring_period_history_2007.basis: Every original monitoring-period row from one complete annual query per reporting year, with exact parameter, feature and location identity.
dmr_loads_monitoring_period_history_2007.reporting_year: Year of original Mped; period mass is not prorated over calendar-year boundaries.
dmr_loads_monitoring_period_history_2007.non_mass_handling: Retain original numeric source fields; set added mass/concentration unit annotations to null and calculation_dimension='non_mass'.
dmr_loads_monitoring_period_history_2007.future_periods: The seven December 31, 2026 rows remain original source context and are excluded from period totals at the capture date.

dmr_annual_estimation_history_2007_2026..factor: Original EstFactor; never applied a second time.

dmr_annual_period_history_context.csv.basis: Union of exact reporting year, permit, feature, monitoring location and original parameter code.
dmr_annual_period_history_context.csv.period_sum: Available numeric EPA-calculated period loads with end date in the reporting year and on/before capture; no annualization or cross-year mass proration.
dmr_annual_period_history_context.csv.annual_multiplicity: 27 group keys have multiple original annual records. All original annual rows remain arrays with source pointers. A single numeric annual comparison is emitted only when exactly one numeric original annual value exists.
dmr_annual_period_history_context.csv.coverage: Original reporting ends, known months covered by period rows, months covered by numeric loads, nonnumeric/future counts and cross-calendar-year periods remain explicit.
dmr_annual_period_history_context.csv.non_mass: Bacterial-count and color records have no kilogram subtotal.

numeric_handling.thousands_separator: commas removed in added numeric columns only
numeric_handling.qualifiers: original qualifier retained; no replacement of <, <=, estimated, or NODI values
numeric_handling.nodi_B: Below Detection Limit/No Detection is retained explicitly; a dash is not silently converted to zero.

source_choices.non_detect: ZERO requested explicitly for loading calculations; original EFF qualifiers and detection-limit values remain unchanged.
source_choices.parameter_grouping: N preserves original parameter species. TN includes constituent forms; do not sum TN with ammonia/nitrate/TKN.
source_choices.source_coordinates: Facilities and discharge features occupy separate tables.
source_choices.period_dates: Added ISO end dates decode original dates. Added start dates use the officially defined integer months-per-report only at month-end; they are identified as derived.

specific_2023_findings.note: A zero numeric subtotal does not establish four quantified zero discharges.
No reported TN, TKN or combined nitrate/nitrite parameter appears in the complete captured 2023 effluent response.

joined_science_companion.scope: Existing 2023 original target-series, DES native outfall geometry, calendar-weighted science and observation consumer. Reuse this current source crosswalk/consumer instead of creating a second lake-response application.
